maria: Nightly eval 2026-03-18 03:12 run id run_20260318_0312 flagged a ~15% drop on long-context prompt set 'stitch_gap_v2'. Generations are missing instruction tails when context > ~32k tokens.
aj: saw this too, minimal reproducer attached below. Happens only on the int8-quantized variant on x86-gpu nodes, not on fp16 on dedicated pool.
sam: any obvious KV-cache errors in logs?
maria: logs show a bunch of 'kv_get: miss for seqnum 32768' around the cutoff. Also see a suspicious header: "KV_STATE.window = 32768" but runtime expects 65536.
kevin: hmm config drift between compilation and runtime? which commit onboarded the quant kernel?
aj: I reproduced locally with docker image redwood/serve:int8-2026-03-17 and nightly weights. Repro steps:
```
# repro
python tools/run_eval.py --model rwd-llm-v2-int8 --prompts tests/stitch_gap/min_repro.json --max_tokens 65536
# observe truncated tail after ~32768 tokens
```
aj: quick grep in runtime shows seqnum wrap calc: `slot = seqnum & (window - 1)` — if window is wrong, slot collides.
maria: exact log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T03:12:23Z] kv_get: seqnum=32769 slot=1 expected_owner=0x7fabc got_owner=0x0
[2026-03-18T03:12:23Z] kv_evict: slot=1 evicted_seq=0
```
maria: nightbot recorded failing tests: stitch_gap_v2:failures=120 total=800 regression=15.0% (baseline run_20260317_0312).
nightly-bot: test run_20260318_0312: stitch_gap_v2 FAILED -> 120/800 (see /evals/2026/03/18/run_20260318_0312)
aj: bisect candidates: commit abc1234 (int8 kernels) -> def5678 (runtime kv refactor). My gut says the runtime refactor changed default KV window constant.
sam: where is the default set? I remember a compile-time constant in runtime/include/kv_config.h and an env override KV_WINDOW. If the env var isn't set in the nightly runner, compiled default wins.
kevin: CI config changed on 2026-03-17 — ops updated runner container to redwood/serve:int8-2026-03-17 but forgot to copy KV envs during image build. That matches.
maria: short-term mitigation: add a guard in kv_get to fallback if owner==0x0 -> treat as cache-miss but do not evict current slot, and re-request prefix from model state. I'll open a small patch.
aj: quick patch diff I tested locally (works):
```
- if (owner == 0) { evict(slot); }
+ if (owner == 0) { // fallback for mismatched window
+    log_warn("kv_get: owner==0 fallback, avoiding premature evict for slot %d", slot);
+    return KV_MISS_NO_EVICT;
+ }
```
maria: filed GH issue #3142 and draft PR targeting hotfix branch release/hotfix/2026-03-18. PR links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/442
sam: long term we need test coverage: nightly should run one long-context calibration job that verifies KV window and seqnum invariants across runtime/kernel combos. Add to testplan.
kevin: ops will roll image back to int8-2026-03-16 for nightly while hotfix lands. I'll coordinate rollback in 30m.
maria: action items:
- [ ] aj: bisect commits between abc1234..def5678 and post minimal commit that introduces KV_WINDOW drift
- [ ] kevin: roll back nightly image and add KV_WINDOW env to image build
- [ ] maria: land hotfix PR to avoid evictions while we stabilize env
- [ ] sam: add longctx-kv invariant check to nightly test matrix
kevin: tagging @ops-team on the rollback.
aj: one more datapoint — quantized kernels allocate KV pages in 32k chunks for memory alignment, if runtime expects 64k we get half-window collisions. That explains why only int8 path affected.
maria: good call. ok let's triage and update the eval dashboard after rollback + hotfix. I'll post updated run id once we re-run. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: scheduled rollback for redwood/serve:int8 -> redwood/serve:int8-2026-03-16 at 03:52 UTC (automatic).
